Added today PROPERTY TYPE House BEDROOMS 3 BATHROOMS 3 SIZE 2,467 sq ft 229 sq m TENURE Freehold 1 +9 Description A beautifully refurbished modern home, finished to an exceptional standard and set within a highly sought after cobbled mews in Belgravia, with the added benefit of off-street parking. Covering approximately 2,467 square feet, this particularly attractive house comprises a kitchen and dining room on the ground floor, a first floor reception room, and principal bedroom suite on the top floor. There are two further bedroom suites, a study and a media room. The house has air conditioning throughout and a private secure garage. Eaton Mews North is a particularly quiet cobbled mews which runs off Lyall Street, between Eaton Square and Eaton Place. It is conveniently located just 0.3 miles from Elizabeth Street’s local shops, restaurants and cafes and only 0.3 and 0.6 miles from Sloane Square (District/Circle) and Victoria Station (Victoria/Circle/District Line), respectively. (All distances and times are approximate). Incorporated within our experience of looking after private individuals is advising family offices and private Trusts on their residential property needs.
